title: CLUTCH OPERATED NEUTRAL STARTING SWITCH
summary: Manual-transmission clutch safety switch (clutch start switch / neutral safety switch) under the dash, mounted on the brake pedal housing (pedal support bracket) beside the clutch pedal. The switch is held by a screw; a rod links the switch lever to the clutch pedal arm, retained by bushings and clip retainers at each end. The switch plugs into the instrument panel harness via the neutral safety switch connector.

parts.name: SWITCH ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Switch assembly – clutch operated neutral start (clutch safety switch)

parts.name: ROD
parts.name_expanded: Rod – clutch pedal to neutral start switch

fastening.note: Screw [1] goes through the switch [4] mounting flange into the side of the brake pedal housing.
The bent upper end of rod [5] passes through a bushing [2] in the clutch pedal arm and is retained on the far side by bushing [2] and clip retainer [3].
The lower end of rod [5] goes through the switch [4] lever and is held by clip retainer [3].
